name: Mairon Santos
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: A Brazilian (17-1, age 26) from Xtreme Couture, winner of The Ultimate Fighter 32 at featherweight. He is 4-0 in the UFC and moves to lightweight after missing weight for his win over Muhammadjon Naimov in December 2025.

how_they_fight.Striking: Busy, with power: nine knockouts in our data (four in R1, two in R2, three in R3).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Wins on the cards against strikers who can't wrestle him (Yusuff, Marshall split).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Finishes late as well as early; three R3 knockouts.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Steady; won a split over Marshall.

patterns: Late finishes as well as early (three R3 knockouts)
concerns: Against the most dangerous striker he has faced
keys_to_beat: Out-hit him early before he settles

news.text: Moves to lightweight for this fight after missing the featherweight limit for the Naimov fight.
